name: Medify VR
summary:
Medify VR – Immersive Orthopedic Surgery Training

Medify VR is an immersive virtual reality simulation that revolutionizes the way orthopedic surgery is learned. Combining AI-driven guidance with realistic interactive scenarios, Medify VR allows medical students and professionals to practice surgical procedures safely and gain hands-on experience without risk to patients.

Key Features

🕹️ Hands-on Practice: Master surgical tools—from clamps to saws—in a high-fidelity environment.

🧠 Deep Immersion: Navi
